claims.statement: SinglePageExternalSourceSyncState (migration 0053) tracks one row per (project, source) with sheet_url + sheet_gid pinned to a single gid; auto_sync_enabled is per-row with no global kill switch, and the daily cadence is pinned to a wall-clock time via Settings.kb_sync_cron registered through register_unique_cron_tick in app/main.py lifespan.

The tick enqueues one RQ job per auto-sync row with a deterministic job_id=f"single-page-ext-src-sync-{state_id}-{today}", making the daily re-enqueue idempotent and introspectable; the manual "Xử lý ngay" path calls sync_single_page_external_source directly with the same code path.

sync_single_page_external_source acquires a Redis lock (single_page_ext_sync:{state_id}) with a random owner token and Lua-guarded release so a crashed predecessor's lock is never torn down by the next attempt; LOCKED outcome re-raises so RQ retries after the lock TTL.

The sync flow validates the DIRECT_CONTEXT project, fetches the CSV via SheetClient with SINGLE_PAGE_SHEET_MAX_BYTES cap, runs render_sheet_markdown deterministically (same CSV → same Markdown), validates the body via DirectContextFileUpsert, then hash-gates against canonical_direct_file_stats.content_sha256 so an unchanged sheet returns NO_OP with one CSV fetch + one hash compare.

The upsert runs under db.begin_nested() so a caught exception only rolls back the diff; on any caught failure the prior Markdown stays in place and the row records last_status=FAILED + last_error=<code> (project_invalid, parse_failed:csv_field_too_large, sheet_parse_failed, direct_file_rejected:content_too_large, direct_file_update_failed, no_sync_actor).

On OK, _enqueue_direct_context_index stages a direct_context chunk into knowledge_chunks so sheet-synced content participates in cross-project retrieval (mirroring the admin-UI publish path); the enqueue is best-effort and swallows Redis errors so a transient queue failure never rolls back the sync.

Two Redis counters track outcomes (single_page_external_source_sync_success_total and _failure_total, 7-day TTL); consecutive_failures is incremented on each FAILED outcome and the operator can silence a misbehaving source by setting auto_sync_enabled=false without deleting the row.
Sheet URLs are validated against a host allow-list at API entry; the SSRF gate reconstructs the export URL from the parsed sheet id at fetch time so a stored URL is never trusted blindly.
